questions.question: Describe complete core setup: which decks are separated, how the starting city and turn track are determined, the initial round/resource/threat/capital positions, corporation sides and cards, rival allocation, and the initial investment choice. Exclude the simplified first-game setup.
What action cards does each corporation draw in four-player and five/six-player games, in what order, and how are General draws selected? Include Melange.

Describe the active player’s turn, including start-of-turn asset timing, Refresh, end-of-turn abilities, hand limit and passing. When does the Action Phase end and must every player have a turn that round?
List the five deal steps and the order of effect, asset claim and cleanup. Which asset is revealed and can the active player pass on the main offer?

The first, second and third counteroffers are proposed in one deal. How many hand cards must each proposer discard in addition to their offer? Can the active player counter, can an earlier proposer later support, and is there another circuit of counteroffers?
In a deal with a counteroffer, who may support, how are cards committed and counted, may a player support both or add more later, and who wins a2–2 tie? What happens if nobody counteroffers?

How can an emergency be proposed or used as support, does it count toward hand size or hand-card theft, and where/state does a stolen emergency return after winning or losing an offer? What may Bryan Stinson steal?

An exploited district prints primary2 credits and secondary1 entertainment, has a development, an orgcrime unit and is in protest. What does it produce and what is its resulting unrest? How would starting in strike or outage change production, and do non-android districts produce in the normal Production Phase?

When an android district with Human First is exploited, what happens from stable, protest, strike, and already-outage starting states? Is an ordinary failed unrest increase without Human First enough to cause an outage?

An orgcrime unit is placed into a district already containing orgcrime and its route then meets a prisec-protected district before eventually reaching the Root. Explain its movement, reserve/threat result and contract consequences. How do android moves differ?

When does illness add threat during an action, including chosen districts and failed placements/moves? If several ill districts are involved is the increase multiplied? Do production or events trigger illness, and what does an illness token entering the Root do?
State each corporation’s contract payment and trigger, who may resolve the triggering action, and the important Haas-Bioroid, NBN, Root and Melange exceptions.

What may players trade or give away, what items cannot be traded after the official erratum, and when are immediate, future-promise, disputed-binding and three-player trades binding? Does an exhausted traded asset ready?

Explain asset timing when several abilities share a timing, what is optional, when exhausted assets ready, and whether a newly gained End of Turn asset can be used this turn. How often can each End of Turn ability be used?

Give the full demand-round order, including what happens when only one resource misses its target, when supplies reset and unchosen investments go, and which steps are omitted in the third demand round.

The third demand fails and pushes threat to25. Does investment scoring happen first, and who wins if the Federalist has25 capital? Contrast finishing that demand below25, a tie with your named rival, and having your own rival card at4 versus5–6 players.

Which information may players communicate about action hands, hand counts, rival cards, investments, hidden turn-track assets, and event cards seen through a reorder effect? What does Thomas Haas require you to announce?

Where do discarded action cards, assets and removed components go? What happens if an action deck is empty when a card must be drawn, a reserve component runs out, or production would pass the track end?

How are a standard round’s phases ordered, which districts get exploited and in what order, and how is an event resolved, discarded and used to set the next turn track? Must that track be reset after the sixth standard round?

Is resolving Liquidation exploitation, and which production modifiers apply? How do Unorthodox Knowledge and Caprice Nisei interact, including whether the resolving player is bound by the announced resolution?

What is the per-district limit for androids, developments, illnesses, outages, prisec, Human First and orgcrime? Can Human First and orgcrime coexist, which duplicate incoming components move, and may the spare fourth android be added to play?
A corporation has44 capital, then loses7. Where and which side is its capital token before and after? Do the bright multiples-of-five spaces award anything?
With Braintrust, what does four-player Globalsec draw and what is its hand limit? What does Melange draw, and may its doubled General cards all come from one type?

What changes when Floyd2X3A7C is claimed, and what is a normal player’s hand limit while owning it? If Floyd is gained by trade instead, is the five-card draw repeated and does the hand limit benefit apply?
What does Toshiyuki Sakai do when claimed, how many actions are drawn in total, and is the hand-size exception permanent?
At the start of another player’s turn, they have12 capital and Lily Lockwell’s owner has10. What may Lily do, is the stolen card random, when relative to Refresh, and what if both have10?
When may Rachel Beckmann draw, including during another player’s deal, what hand condition and card type apply, and does a faceup emergency stop it?

Aaron Marrón’s owner proposes the third counteroffer; another player later proposes the fourth. How many extra cards are paid for each, where do those paid cards go, and does Aaron intercept support-card discards?
A supporting player abstains. When and at what cost can Eiko respond, and what choices must that player then make?
How does The Fall Guy allow an active player to make a counteroffer, what is discarded, what step follows immediately, and can Chief Gorman cancel that counteroffer?

When may Chief Gorman be used on an ordinary counteroffer, what payment avoids its return, and what happens to the proposer’s status, further counteroffers and already-paid proposal discards if returned?
For an ordinary offered action other than Unorthodox Knowledge, when and at what cost may Caprice Nisei act, and is the proposer then free to change the announced resolution?

At the start of Support, Isabel McGuire’s owner puts a deck card beside the counteroffer. Is the owner treated as supporting that offer, may an eligible owner then support the main offer normally, and does Locust Company’s restriction on that owner block Isabel’s deck card?
When and at what cost does Locust Company restrict a player, which offer/card source is restricted, and may that player still support the main offer from hand?
When are Midori and Tanaka used, what cost does each have, and which one requires a support tie? What winners may each choose?
After a player proposes an offer, what may Mark Yale do, who becomes unable to trade, what kinds of trades are blocked, and for how long?
When using Naoko Watanabe, what is discarded and what is claimed? If the first gained asset has a when-claimed effect, does it wait until after the second claim?

Sunny LeBeau is present when one effect increases threat by3, and later an event sends two orgcrime units into the Root in separate instances. How many times can Sunny trigger in each case, what may be drawn each time, and does an exhaust cost apply?
What threat increases trigger Wong Ya Ching and how much capital does it award? Does ordinary demand failure or an orgcrime moving to the Root qualify merely because it increases threat?
Describe Elizabeth Mills’s End of Turn ownership change and who chooses its following effect. What are the two effects, and which action type is used for the draw?
What does Susan Chen do at End of Turn and in what order? If the active player receives her during their End of Turn step, can they use her that turn?
With Alex Westlund, what cards can be swapped, when is the capital cost paid if one selected asset is yours, can Alex himself be selected, and do those assets count as claimed?
What may Bernice Mai do at End of Turn, how is capital calculated, and can this ability give emergency actions despite the prohibition on freely trading hand actions?
Fumiko Yamamori is used at End of Turn. What resource condition and payment apply, how much capital is gained, and can a resource at0 be chosen for free income?
Marco Cubrero is used when two other players tie for most capital. What are the one-capital and two-capital options, and must the richer target be unique?
When using Jackson Howard, when is the prediction made, what cost applies, can you choose yourself, and what produces the capital payment?
Whose deal victory pays Coach Walden? When may Monica Singh steal, and who is the target? When Saul Eustecio is used, which player wins the deal and who gains capital in what order?
At End of Turn, how do Mr. Li and Mr. White differ in targeting, capital change, drawing versus inspecting/stealing, and who can be chosen?
What does Hernando Cortez do on being claimed, and if he steals an exhausted asset, does that asset ready or trigger its when-claimed ability? What alternative is available?
Describe every emergency action’s printed effect in order, including quantities, later consequences, who chooses Energy for All’s types, and any illness exception.
Labor Solutions is resolved with multiple androids. How many may move, can two occupied android districts simply swap simultaneously, what later component is placed, and is illness waived?
How does Efficiency Experts move an android and treat illness? Contrast its illness handling with a normal action involving an ill departure/destination.

Liquidation targets a district with Human First, orgcrime, development, primary2credits and secondary1entertainment, currently stable. State its produced resources and final unrest, and whether Human First’s exploitation outage rule applies.
High-Risk Investments selects three players. How does the selection order affect their capital, and does the offer’s resolver have to be one of those recipients?
For Puff Piece, who chooses card types, what is the draw amount for someone who supported the winning offer versus someone who did not, is drawing optional, and in what order?
Spin Doctors resolves when supply credits are0. What unrest changes are available, what replaces the credit reduction, and what if credits instead started at1?

Media Circus is resolved in a district in strike. What happens to that unrest and what later unit must be placed? For24/7 Live Feeds, what alternative effect can be chosen instead of decreasing unrest?
Full Deployment chooses another player. Who chooses between its effects and chooses the card type, what are those effects, and may the resolver target themself?
For Riot Control, what component is removed first, what may then be removed and from where, what unrest consequence follows, and is the sacrificed prisec an enemy for Globalsec’s contract?

State Arrest Orders’ printed placement/removal instruction and distinguish units from tokens. State Scorched Earth’s required outage destination and the geographic scope of enemy removal. Do not assume an impossible-cost or simultaneous-priority ruling.

Gentrification is resolved in a district with an outage and enemy units. What happens in order, and do the forced enemy movements count as removals for Globalsec? In a separate case the target has an outage and an existing prisec but no enemies: is a second prisec placed?
Budget Renovations removes two outages. Which districts gain unrest, at what stage do they finish if nothing else intervenes, and can the unrest penalty be placed elsewhere?
Vanity Project chooses a player who supported its offer but has no assets. What capital is awarded, is the grant prevented by having no asset to discard, and how would a nonsupporter’s grant differ?

For Clean Slate, how many illnesses may be removed, where must its later outage be placed, and does illness add threat during it? How does Clinical Trials differ in removal amount and illness handling?
In a five-player Information Procurement, contributions in active-clockwise order total4 or total6. What is the threat change in each, is each player required to pay1, and is overpaying forbidden?
For Unorthodox Knowledge, how many event cards are inspected, where are they returned and in what order, and may their fronts be shared?
Energy Sector has supply3 against demand4, then consider supply0 against demand0 and supply5 against demand2. What capital is earned in each, and does its formula count all supply or only surplus?

Banking and Entertainment Sector each have supply5 meeting demand. Retail has consumables2 meeting demand; Technology has tech1 meeting demand. Calculate each capital award and state the corresponding formula/cap.

At investment scoring there are3 illness tokens,1 orgcrime,2 prisec,2 outages and4 Human First in the city. What are Healthcare Initiative, Laundering Scheme, Militarized Police, Power Siphoning and Union Agreement’s awards? Are tier awards cumulative?

For Populist Dismissal, two districts are in protest, three in strike and two in outage. What is its award? For Short Sale, supply amounts across five resource types are0,1,1,2,4: what is the award and what is being counted?

Helium-3 Transport Threatened is revealed with outages in both tier2 and tier3; then consider outages only in tier1. What upper-half threat result applies in each, and is the check before or after its lower placement list?

Human First Starts Riot has a Human First in tier2; Beanstalk Beset by Protesters has one in tier3. What does each upper effect do? If its required tier has no Human First, what happens instead and in what order?

For Beanstalk Owned by Mob? and Pistoleros Hit Squads Strike!, which tier triggers the upper fixed threat and how much? If the relevant tier is empty but orgcrime exists elsewhere, what happens instead? Can those moves still increase threat?
Activist Cells Awaken is resolved with Human First in several districts. What is the movement order and how many moves per unit, and do duplicate/prisec blocking and the Root still apply?

Explain the different upper-half conditions for Report: Record Unemployment, Average Wage Falls Again and Earthquake Rocks City, including what happens below their thresholds. What do Social Apps Spark Revolution and Welfare Programs Slashed count?

What do Humanity Labor Hosts Union Heads, Gang Wars at All-Time High!/Tri-Maf Leaders Unite!, and Crumbling Infrastructure/Rolling Outages Increase count for upper-half threat? Are new lower-half placements included in that earlier count?
How many standard and demand rounds are in the core game, when are demand rounds interleaved, and does a demand round contain the ordinary Action/Production/Event sequence?
A player has seven action cards when someone else ends their turn. Must that player immediately discard to five? When is the normal hand-size check made and which player discards?
Several ordinary counteroffers remain faceup in the Counteroffer box. Which one can win and resolve, can an earlier one resolve instead, and what role do the earlier cards retain?
How do you identify primary and secondary resource icons? If a district has only one resource icon and an orgcrime unit plus a development, what can it produce under ordinary production?

Threat is23 when an event’s upper effect adds2, before its lower-half placements. The Federalist has24 capital. Must players finish those placements or wait for later income before determining the result, and who wins?
Describe ordinary unrest stages and token representation. What are the results of decreasing strike by1, protest by1, and stable by1, and what unrest remains after removing an outage?

If Learn to Play and Rules Reference conflict, which controls? If an asset contradicts Rules Reference, what controls, and should both be followed when compatible? How are the official2018 FAQ corrections treated?

When can Thomas Haas be used, which rival may its owner inspect, what swap is permitted, and in what orientation do the two rivals remain? What must be announced, and is Thomas exhausted or discarded to use this ability?

An owned asset is already exhausted when its trigger occurs again before its owner’s next Refresh. Can the owner pay its exhaust cost again? How is exhaustion represented, and when and how does it ready normally?
May a counteroffer be another copy of the action proposed as the main offer or of an earlier counteroffer? Does having the same name make it illegal?
How do you identify a district’s tier on the board, and does being in a higher tier inherently change its production or threat?
What cost activates Isabel McGuire’s support contribution, when may it be used, which card source can be chosen, how many cards are placed, and which offers may receive them?
Compare Coach Walden, Monica Singh and Saul Eustecio: which printed effect requires exhausting its asset, which effects have no exhaust cost, and are Monica’s and Saul’s abilities optional?
A supply resource is already at0 when a normal instruction would reduce it. Can its supply become negative? Distinguish a card with an explicit alternative at0 from this normal supply limit.

May players inspect ordinary action cards as they are discarded or while in the facedown discard pile? May they inspect the investment deck after investments have been dealt? When an action is stolen or given by an effect, must its identity be revealed to other players?

After the final turn of an Action Phase, to whom is the active-player token passed? Who takes the first turn of the next standard round after Production/Event and any intervening demand round: is the initial first player restored?

generic_reader_process.role: Process instructions only; no game facts. Frozen summary is sole rules authority.
generic_reader_process.instruction: Execute this exact generic code in memory; choose relevant offsets yourself; construct every evidence unit with extract_unit(summary,offset) and verify using validate_record(summary,record). Also include any controlling table introduction/legend/definition. No external helper file is allowed. Keep factual scoring separate from format diagnostics.
